description: Shared base config for sebdanielsson repositories. See README.md.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates of stable (1.0 and later) dependencies once required checks pass. A repository opts a package out with a later rule that sets automerge to false.
Update Stylelint together with its configs and plugins. They declare peer ranges on stylelint, so a major bump of one alone breaks the install until the others catch up.

Only Docker Hub exposes release timestamps. GHCR/Quay/ECR tags have none, so with the Renovate 42 default (minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-required) their updates stay in 'Pending Status Checks' forever instead of ever getting a PR.
